content_zh:
当博九说出这句话之后，眼前的人就犹如雷击到了一般，朝着门外冲了出去，一边冲着一边喊：“医生，医生！我家少爷的脑子坏了！”
少爷？指的是她？
博九意识到了有什么地方不对劲儿，眉头狠狠的皱了一下。
恍惚之间，似乎有东西正在试图冲进她的大脑里！
她甩了甩自己发疼的头，迷茫的眸光对上了眼前的穿衣镜。
镜子里倒影出来了一个少年，身材挺拔修长，大约十七岁左右，一双漆黑的眸，线条清晰而流畅。
最完美的就是她的皮肤，玉瓷般的透白，从鼻梁到下巴，都漂亮的无可挑剔。
一头凌乱的银色短发非但没有让她颓废，反而增添了她奢贵的气质，宛如东方的吸血贵族。，
少年的耳朵上还带着一颗黑色的耳钉，散发着隐隐的芒。
张扬，嚣张，帅气！
这是所有人见到少年第一眼，都会感觉到东西。
如果不是她在照镜子，就连博九都会觉得镜子里的人是个男孩。
然而，她很清楚，无论是她，还是现在的这具身体，都是个女孩。
博九看着镜子里的自己，忽然闭上了眼睛，过了几秒钟再睁开，双眸里是猜不透的神秘莫测。
“少爷！”刚刚跑出去的人又跑了进来，手上还拽着一个医生：“快，快给我家少爷看看，瞧瞧他是不是脑子坏掉了！”
医生拿着医用照明灯，看了看博九的眼睛。
博九不动神色的坐着，并没有反抗。
她在接受大脑不断传来的讯息。
这个身体虽然和她同名同姓，景况却截然不同。
明明是个女儿身，她母亲却从小把她装扮成了男生。

但是再怎么养，这具身体喜欢的还是男人。
而且到了高中，女孩子都会心动。
她则是心动的太厉害，又不懂女孩子该有的矜持，看见帅哥就直接围上去转。
所以她才会被人当成弯的打进了医院。
等到博九把这些都记起来的时候，脸色不是很好看。
她曾经能用一台电脑攻克五角大楼。
许多国际刑警为了能够抓住她，美男计美女计都用过，十个黑人都不够她揍。
被人打到重伤住院这种事……真的是，让人有点想笑。
而博九确实也笑了出来，只不过那双眼睛还是冷的，深邃的黑中透着一丝丝的邪佞。
“少爷？”陈晓东疑惑的看着她。
博九漫不经心的看了他一眼，然后抬起手来将银发按在脑后，露出了那张宛如恶魔的完美脸庞。
“嗯？”
连声音都完美的无可挑剔，不会太低也不会太高，带着少年特有的质感，温柔而磁性。
明明再普通不过的动作，由她做出来却多了一份飞扬跋扈的味道。
陈晓东一愣，他总觉得少爷好像有哪里不一样了。
怎么说呢，以前的少爷动不动就会发脾气，拿钱不当钱的糟，浑身多充斥着一股我是“暴发户”的气息。
可今天，他只在少爷的身上看到了帅气这两个字…

content_en:
When Bo Jiu said these words, the person in front of him rushed out of the door as if struck by lightning, shouting at the same time: "Doctor, doctor! My young master's brain is broken!"
Master? Referring to her?
Bo Jiu realized something was wrong and frowned hard.
Suddenly, it seemed like something was trying to get into her brain!
She shook her aching head and looked at the full-length mirror in front of her with confused eyes.
A young man was reflected in the mirror. He was tall and slender, about seventeen years old, with a pair of dark eyes with clear and smooth lines.
The most perfect thing is her skin, which is as white as jade and porcelain. From the bridge of her nose to her chin, she is impeccably beautiful.
The messy silver short hair not only did not make her decadent, but instead added to her luxurious temperament, like an oriental vampire aristocrat. ,
The young man also had a black earring on his ear, emitting a faint glow.
Flamboyant, arrogant, handsome!
This is the first thing everyone will feel when they see the boy.
If she hadn't been looking in the mirror, even Bo Jiu would have thought the person in the mirror was a boy.
However, she knew very well that both she and this body were still a girl.
Bo Jiu looked at himself in the mirror and suddenly closed his eyes. After a few seconds, he opened them again. There was an unfathomable mystery in his eyes.
"Young Master!" The person who just ran out ran in again, dragging a doctor by the hand: "Quick, show my young master to see if his brain is broken!"
The doctor took a medical light and looked into Bo Jiu's eyes.
Bo Jiu sat calmly and did not resist.
She is receiving messages from her brain.
Although this body has the same name as hers, the situation is completely different.
She is obviously a girl, but her mother has dressed her up as a boy since she was a child.
But no matter how you raise it, this body still likes men.
And by high school, girls are all excited.
On the other hand, her heart was too excited and she didn't understand how a girl should be reserved. When she saw a handsome guy, she immediately surrounded him.
That's why she was treated as a crook and sent to the hospital.
When Bo Jiu remembered all this, his face didn't look very good.
She was once able to take over the Pentagon with a computer.
In order to catch her, many Interpol policemen used all kinds of tricks to catch her. Even ten black men were not enough to beat her up.
Being beaten up and being seriously injured and being hospitalized... it really makes me laugh.
And Bo Jiu did laugh, but his eyes were still cold, with a hint of evil in the deep black.
"Master?" Chen Xiaodong looked at her doubtfully.
Bo Jiu glanced at him casually, then raised his hand to push his silver hair back on his head, revealing his perfect devil-like face.
"Huh?"
Even the voice is impeccable, not too low or too high, with the unique texture of a boy, gentle and magnetic.
The seemingly ordinary movements, but made by her, had a more domineering flavor.
Chen Xiaodong was stunned. He always felt that something was different about the young master.
How should I put it? In the past, the young master would lose his temper at every turn, and he would mishandle money as money. His whole body was filled with the aura that I was a "nouveau riche".
But today, he only saw the word handsome on the young master...
If you like the national school girl, please be a girl.
